'''''Koh-Lanta 2018''''' was the planned twenty-third season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'', but was canceled after five days of filming following allegations of sexual assault from a male castaway to a female castaway; it was never broadcast. 

== Production ==
During filming of the 2018 regular season in Fiji, allegations of sexual assault from a male castaway to a female castaway prompted shooting to be suspended.<ref>https://twitter.com/Alpfr/status/994930080257261568</ref>

It is alleged that Candide Renard, the daughter of football manager {{Wp|Hervé Renard}}, was harassed by a fellow castaway. Between the 4th and 5th days of filming, Candide was sleeping away from the camp with the man and two other castaways. When the man in question allegedly harassed her, she called the production team and both were relocated away from camp in separate locations.<ref>https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2018/05/246313/was-herve-renards-daughter-sexually-assaulted</ref>

However, the man's version of events contradicts Candide's account. He said that a castaway fell ill, and another called production for medical assistance. At that point, Candide went back to the shelter alongside the rest of the tribe. Whilst Candide alleges this is where the assault took place, another castaway said he never witnessed the alleged assault.<ref>https://www.telestar.fr/tele-realite/koh-lanta/nouvelle-edition/eddy-guyot-koh-lanta-pourquoi-je-suis-innocent-351453</ref><ref>https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2018/05/246313/was-herve-renards-daughter-sexually-assaulted</ref>

As a result of the accusation, filming of the season was halted and cancelled. The man was arrested upon his return to France, but was released after 10 hours of questioning. He denied the accusation.

It later emerged that the male castaway had been arrested twice in the past for violent behaviour, in 2008 and 2012, and served a total of 18 months in prison. In response to this, {{Wp|Benjamin Castaldi}}, host of ''[[wikipedia:Loft_Story_(French_TV_series)|Loft Story]]'' and former host of ''[[wikipedia:Secret_Story_(French_TV_series)|Secret Story]]'' (the French adaptations of reality TV show ''[[wikipedia:Big_Brother_(franchise)|Big Brother]]'') said he was surprised that TF1 did not perform a background check on the castaways before casting them on the show.<ref>https://www.francesoir.fr/societe-faits-divers/affaire-candide-renard-eddy-guyot-le-profil-violent-du-candidat-de-koh-lanta</ref>

The "War of the Chiefs" theme and three tribe format (along with the same colors) was eventually reused in the following season.

Some contestants from this cancelled season have been included in the cast of subsequent seasons: 
* [[Sam Haliti]] and [[Pholien Systermans]] from {{S2|24fr}}.<ref>https://tvmag.lefigaro.fr/programme-tv/alexia-laroche-joubert-nous-voulions-des-heros-qui-n-avaient-jamais-gagne-koh-lanta_8eb6bb88-53c3-11ea-b696-60b802b9a2f3</ref>
* [[Aurélien Tesson]]<ref>https://tvmag.lefigaro.fr/programme-tv/aurelien-koh-lanta-un-plaisir-immense-de-me-voir-offrir-une-deuxieme-chance_c60bfe22-827a-11eb-84fa-ffc0e6724a5b</ref> and [[Hervé Comte|Hervé Comté]]<ref>https://www.programme-tv.net/news/tele-realite/272098-koh-lanta-2021-voici-le-nom-des-deux-candidats-presents-dans-les-armes-secretes-qui-avaient-participe-a-la-saison-annulee/</ref> from {{S2|26fr}}.
* [[Fouzi Ould Bouamama]] <ref>https://www.voici.fr/news-people/fouzi-koh-lanta-2022-ce-secret-quil-a-prefere-ne-pas-reveler-aux-autres-aventuriers-730100</ref> from {{S2|28fr}}.

==Twists==
* '''War of the Chiefs:''' for once, this season will start with the famous "Poles Challenge" (a classic in [[Koh-Lanta]]). The three castaways who will remain the longest on their pole will get to spend the night together and decide how the tribes will be divided. Each of them will then become the "Chief" of a tribe. They will be able to attend the other tribes' Tribal Councils, until the merge. Each chief has an important role during the Challenges. They have to lead their tribe to victory, and accept the defeat for their tribe. At each Reward Challenge, the chief of the winning tribe must make a choice between two rewards. The one which they have not picked then goes to the tribe which arrived in second place.
* '''Chief Immunity Bracelet:''' Each chief starts the game with a ''Chief Immunity Bracelet'' which functions just like a [[Hidden Immunity Idol]] and once they play out their bracelet, they lose their special status. Their tribes need to agree ''unanimously'' on the name of a new chief who will then receive a new bracelet. If a tribe fails to agree, the chiefs of the other two tribe need to decide for them.
* '''Three Tribes:''' The game started with three [[tribe]]s instead of the usual two. A blue tribe was added in the mix with the traditional red and yellow tribes.
* '''Replacement:''' Due to a [[Evacuation|medical evacuation]], one castaway (Sylvie) would return to the game after being voted out.

==Chiefs History==
The three castaways who stood the longest on their pole during the opening "Poles Challenge" earned the right to become '''Tribe Chief'''. More than just the chiefs composed the tribes on Day 2 and have important roles to play in every challenges : they have to lead their tribe to victory, and accept the defeat for their tribe. For example, at each Reward Challenge, the chief of the winning tribe must make a choice between two rewards. The one which they have not picked then goes to the tribe which arrived in second place.

The chiefs start the game with an Immunity Bracelet (which works just like a regular [[Hidden Immunity Idol]]) and also have the opportunity to attend the other tribes' Tribal Councils, until the merge. Thus, they gain important insight on the dynamics of their rival tribes.

A chief can be dethroned by being voted out or by playing their Chief Immunity Bracelet. The following day, the remaining tribe members need to choose a new chief unanimously. If they cannot come to a unanimous agreement, then, the chiefs from the opposite two tribes must decide for them. Once a new chief is chosen, they receive their own Chief Immunity Bracelet.
